mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion that increases corporate earnings expectations and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in positive GDP growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market weakness that triggers fiscal stimulus expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it signals robust manufacturing and construction sectors that support corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed 12-month averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly retail sales decline exceeding 0.5% (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of instances when RSAFS monthly change < -0.5% in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% signals inflationary pressures that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic recovery regime, an employment decline below 140,000 thousand persons (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 140000 in post-pandemic recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises and real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds its 12-month average, it signals strong economic growth that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 65% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 exceed 12-month averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
